Identified as this saint because: Found by route 2: Wikidata Q1545017 «Григорий Омиритский», this folder's stored Russian form exactly, has P373 `Category:Gregentios of Zafar`, and Commons titles this file for Gregentios himself. The entity is the archbishop of Zafar in Himyar, which is the saint this folder keeps on 19 December in all four calendars under the Greek «Γρηγέντιος» and the Serbian «Григорије (Григентије)»; 'of Ethiopia' and 'of Zafar' are the two ways the calendars name the Homeritan see. A single-figure fresco, 678x989, PD-Art (PD-old-70) as Commons states it. The category's larger files are two manuscript pages of his Life rather than his portrait.
